scope: Published production acceptance and descriptive whole-build measurements; no renderer-only or causal speed claim.

method.coldMeaning: A separate new empty local asset cache before every native build; not a cold CDN, host, network, dependency install or baseline comparison.
method.betweenBuilds: Remove only homepage/build; retain dependency installation and the shared pnpm store.
method.maximumRssMeaning: Reported maximum resident set size from macOS time -l in bytes, not aggregate simultaneous memory of all child processes or isolated native allocations.

intentionalDifferences: Native supported-language output preserves the terminal LF and adds final empty numbered lines 4/5/9.
Token span boundaries/counts and native metadata/class markup differ; unknown fallback gains a visible title.
